title: Animal Lack of Care
description: Use this request to report animals that are sick, injured, in critical condition, left in extreme temperatures, or lacking care (food, water, shelter, etc.). Service requests of this nature are dispatched and responded to based on priority. Priority 2: Instances in which there exists an immediate threat to the life of an animal (domestic or wildlife) will be responded to within 2 hours. Priority 2: Instances in which an animal is subjected to temperatures below 32 degrees Fahrenheit or a heat advisory has been issued will be responded to within 2 hours. Priority 4: Instances in which an animal is sick or has a non-life-threatening injury will be responded to within 6 hours.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for an animal that is sick, injured, or lacking care.
actions.why: Report a domestic or wild animal that is sick, injured, in a truly critical condition, or lacking food, water, shelter, or care. Critical examples in the 311 request form include being hit by a car, active bleeding, exposed bone, unresponsiveness while breathing, little or no movement, or inability to walk on two or more legs. The 311 request form also covers an owned domestic animal left below 32 degrees Fahrenheit or during an active heat advisory, and asks about ownership, the animal’s location, and related care concerns such as tethering or unsanitary conditions.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Animal Lack of Care" requests is not the route the 311 request form gives for animal cruelty, and its extreme-temperature option applies only to owned domestic animals during an active heat advisory or temperatures below 32 degrees Fahrenheit. If the concern is animal cruelty, then call 911.
